block.scp_unleashed.z0004_chest.detail: It smells of salt and smells of a long way down.

dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.title: Fleet of the Damned
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.caption: Z-0004 on the recovery dock, photographed as supplied.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
Z-0004 is not held at any Foundation site. It is supplied through the facility network on request, together with its file, and responsibility for it passes to whoever makes the request.
Z-0004 is to be stored indoors on a dry floor. %rStorage near open water is not advised.%r
**Personnel opening Z-0004 outside storage are to be prepared for an engagement at sea.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.page.1.title: Description:
Z-0004 is a wooden sea chest a little under a metre long, bound in rusted iron bands and fitted with a seized lock. Brain, fan and tube corals, clusters of barnacles and a single starfish grow on its lid and sides, and strands of kelp hang from its rim. The wood is always wet. It does not dry under heat lamps or in sealed desiccant rooms.
Opened in storage, Z-0004 gives a long creak and a breath of cold sea air. The interior holds a little wet sand and nothing else.

Under conditions not yet fully mapped, opening Z-0004 is followed by the toll of a ship's bell and the arrival of Z-0004-1, a large sailing ship in an advanced state of decay that rises out of the water some distance from the chest. Z-0004-1 is crewed by animate skeletal figures, Z-0004-2, overgrown with marine life and dressed in rotted clothing, and commanded by a single figure in a long coat, Z-0004-3.

Z-0004-1 turns its broadside towards those present and opens fire with its cannon. When its hull is broken, the crew abandon ship and carry the fight on in the water, where they move faster than any diver on staff, and on land.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.page.2.title: Addendum Z-0004-1: Test Log
Test Z-41: Z-0004 was opened in a storage bay. A researcher reported the smell of rope and tar for several minutes afterwards.
Test Z-42: Z-0004 was opened beside a decorative pond. Nothing arrived. %rThe pond was judged not to count.%r
Test Z-43: Z-0004 was opened at the end of a pier. Z-0004-1 surfaced roughly forty metres out. Repairs to the pier are ongoing.

Test Z-44: after Z-0004-1 was sunk and every member of its crew destroyed, the lead researcher opened Z-0004 again. It held coin, pearls and a coral-crusted cutlass. It did not respond again for several days.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.page.3.title: Addendum Z-0004-2: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.page.3.text: Z-0004 was found on the deck of a trawler that had come back to port with no crew and a single empty net. The trawler has since been scrapped. Like the other Z-Class objects, its file appeared in the facility network's supply listings without an entry from any department.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.page.4.title: Addendum Z-0004-3: Note
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0004.page.4.text: Teams are reminded that Z-0004-1 does not follow those who leave. %rIt only waits for them to come back.%r
